questions.question: What does every sentence need?
questions.explanation: Every complete sentence needs both a subject (who/what) and a verb (action).

questions.question: Which is a complete sentence?
questions.explanation: "The bird sings" has a subject (the bird) and a verb (sings).

questions.question: What goes at the end of a question?
questions.explanation: Questions end with a question mark: "What is your name?"

questions.question: Which punctuation shows strong feelings?
questions.explanation: An exclamation mark shows strong feelings: "That is amazing!"

questions.question: Put in order: "plays / my sister / tennis"
questions.explanation: The correct order is: subject (My sister) + verb (plays) + object (tennis).
